_comment: Hardware-free DEMO profile for Sentinel-E. Runs the entire platform on a single machine with no external target/attacker. A local telemetry generator (demo/sim_sensor.py) emits the same NDJSON event schema the hardware sensor produces; the UNMODIFIED detection engine decides every alert. IPs below are illustrative fixtures for the simulated attack.

demo._comment: Demo shows the raw observed source IP of every event (no relabelling).

sensor._comment: mode=demo makes the ingestor spawn the LOCAL telemetry generator instead of streaming from a remote host over SSH. mode=hardware (the default in sentinel.conf.json) uses the real Pi sensor.
